name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez practically grew up in a garage, helping her father, a local mechanic, tinker with engines. That early exposure ignited a lifelong passion for motorsport. While she lacked the financial resources to pursue racing directly, Sofia channeled her enthusiasm into engineering. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering, she joined a small racing team, quickly proving her meticulous attention to detail. Her knack for identifying even the smallest flaws before they became major problems earned her a reputation for exceptional quality control.

Over the years, Sofia's experience has broadened, making her a valuable asset. She joined Eurofarma RC five years ago, where she’s become known for her proactive approach to quality. She isn't content with simply meeting standards; Sofia constantly looks for ways to improve processes and performance. Her ambition drives her to push the boundaries of what's possible, ensuring the team's vehicles are always operating at their peak. She is a respected mentor to junior engineers, patiently sharing her knowledge and experience, and a champion for adopting innovative techniques to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and pulled back into a bun
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of average height with a warm, welcoming smile and a pragmatic demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on double-checking every calculation, regardless of who performed it.
Prefers to work in complete silence, except for the occasional hum of machinery.
